summary: Fastcall raster primitive that fills a horizontal pixel run in a strided framebuffer. Normalizes the boundary arguments a2/a3 so a2 <= a3, then calls PixelFillWithStride at base offset a1 + a5 * a2 with count v6 - a2 + 1, pixel value a4, stride a5, and pass-through a6. Legacy ABI name Draw_Rectangle. Shape is a 1-pixel-tall horizontal line drawn at stride a5 starting from boundary a2.

operations.description: Hold the a3 endpoint in v6 before normalization.
If a2 > a3, swap: v6 = a2 and a2 = a3, so the run start a2 is the smaller boundary.
Compute the destination base offset as a1 + a5 * a2 (start boundary a2 times stride a5).
Compute the run length as v6 - a2 + 1 (inclusive pixel count between the boundaries).
Call PixelFillWithStride(a1 + a5 * a2, v6 - a2 + 1, a4, a5, a6) to fill the strided run.
